_comment: Every piece of wording on the website that isn't a business fact in site.json. The owner changes it in the editor (click the words, type, Save, Publish). Copy the client's own words – never invent wording. Keys are used by t()/tBlock()/tList() in src/ (see src/lib/text.mjs). siteFields = site.json fields that are wording (used as key "site.<field>"). kinds = fields that must stay a phone number / email address. mustStay = legal/compliance lines (the editor says they must stay on the website).

text.home.title: UNC-Charlotte Men's Volleyball Club
text.home.lede: The Men's Club Volleyball team is a competitive and traveling club team.
home.about: The team practices regularly and plays at a high level, competing against top ranking collegiate Men's Volleyball Club teams around North Carolina, the Southeast, and all over the nation.
home.league: Our team competes in division II of the Eastern Collegiate Volleyball Association. We play against teams like Liberty University and the 2022 National Champions, Virginia Tech. We only compete in our league during the spring semester, but travel across the east coast during fall semester to compete in tournaments hosted by other universities.
text.home.practice: We practice Monday, Wednesday, and Friday 6-9 at the Student Activities Center (SAC)

text.donate.title: How your contribution helps support the UNC-Charlotte Men's Volleyball Club
donate.body: The men’s volleyball club is committed to providing its players with the opportunity to compete at the highest level, and your generous donations will directly support their journey. Contributions will go towards covering essential travel expenses, including transportation and accommodation, as well as costs for jerseys and necessary equipment like volleyballs.

Additionally, donations will help offset the fees associated with tournament entries, including those for nationals. As the total cost for nationals alone is estimated to be around $10,000, any financial support will significantly alleviate the burden of these expenses and allow the team to focus on their performance and growth.
Your support is crucial to ensuring the success of the team and helping them achieve their competitive goals.
